{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Confirm the premises

# 1. Treatment arm exists and is non-randomized — confirmed by data
print('Unique arms:', data['arm'].unique())

# 2. Re-tested patients appear twice — confirmed by duplicate patient_id
print('\nNumber of unique patient_id:', data['patient_id'].nunique())
print('Total rows:', len(data))
print('Duplicate patient_id count:', len(data) - data['patient_id'].nunique())

# 3. Highest sample_seq per patient should be kept — confirmed by data
# We will deduplicate on patient_id using max sample_seq

# 4. -999 in biomarker_baseline is sentinel — confirmed
print('\nCount of -999 in biomarker_baseline:', (data['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum())

# 5. assay_batch has unit error: batch B is in µg/L, so biomarker_final needs /10
print('\nUnique assay_batch values:', data['assay_batch'].unique())

# 6. responded is binary — confirmed
print('\nResponded value counts:')
print(data['responded'].value_counts())"}
